dct_description_sm: Data set on agreements concluded under the Regulation for a mixed metropolis to improve the supply of social, affordable and family housing (20-041). Since April 1, 2021, for all permits subject to it, the conclusion of an agreement in accordance with the Regulation is required. This regulation aims to improve the supply of social, affordable and family housing in the city.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
